answer: Milestone bond: each agent ties one identity to three milestones on a 70-credit anchor, so fakes must keep pace. Each milestone needs one proof at the inlet for auditors to replay. A miss burns 15 credits toward the nadir; three misses void the bond. Fees run 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Rented milestones fail: one proof reused across identities voids both bonds. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
